name: Pointer swap
notes: Classic: 3 entries of the game's jump tables get the address of another routine the same code jumped to, and the console restarts from that ROM. Every jump still lands on a real routine, so the game keeps running and does the wrong thing with its own parts: an enemy with another enemy's behaviour, a menu that opens the wrong screen, a cutscene step out of order. Needs jump tables: play the game a while first (the Workshop's ROM page says how many it found). Widen the range for bigger games.
